debt_bondage.text: Article 1(a) concerns personal services pledged as debt security where their reasonably assessed value is not applied to repayment, or the length and nature of the services are not limited and defined. A debt or high rate alone does not establish all of those facts. Applicability and any domestic offence require separate legal review.

palermo.text: For analytical screening, Article 3 of the Trafficking Protocol distinguishes acts, specified means and an exploitation purpose. Where those means are used, consent does not negate the intended exploitation; for children under 18 the means element is not required. This framework does not by itself determine a domestic offence, jurisdiction or the facts of this case.
